name: wmaxlev
expr: h100_4 = wmaxlev(100, 'db4'); h2v_4 = wmaxlev([50 100], 'db4'); h1024_h = wmaxlev(1024, 'haar'); h16_1 = wmaxlev(16, 'db1'); h16_4 = wmaxlev(16, 'db4'); h100_c2 = wmaxlev(100, 'coif2'); h100_s4 = wmaxlev(100, 'sym4'); h2048_d10 = wmaxlev(2048, 'db10'); h8_4 = wmaxlev(8, 'db4'); h2_1 = wmaxlev(2, 'db1'); h64_2 = wmaxlev(64, 'db2'); h_88_1 = wmaxlev([8 8], 'db1');
comment: Sig: L = wmaxlev(N, wname). Maximum DWT decomposition level: L = floor(log2(N / (Lf - 1))) where Lf is the wavelet filter length. Vector N (e.g., 2-D image dims) uses min(N). Coverage: wavelet ∈ {haar, db1, db2, db4, db10, sym4, coif2} × N ∈ {2, 8, 16, 64, 100, 1024, 2048} + 2-vector N. tol=0.
